'''Sei Taria''' was a [[human]] who served as an [[aide]] to [[Finis Valorum]] during his [[time]] as [[Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. Under Supreme Chancellor [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], Taria lost her position to [[Sly Moore]] in spite of her posterior attempt to join Palpatine. Taria was a committed and dedicated individual and it was rumored that Moore threatened her with blackmail to get her to step down.

==Biography==
===Aide to the Chancellor===
Sei Taria was a [[human]]<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> who served as [[Senior Administrative Aide|Chief Administratie Aide]]<ref name="Falcon">{{BuildFalconCite|60|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref> in the [[Office of the Chancellor]] to [[Finis Valorum]] during his [[time]] as [[Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] and its [[Galactic Senate]]. After the [[Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo|invaded]] the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] in [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Valorum called a special session of the senate so that [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of Naboo could speak before the senate on behalf of her [[Naboo (people)|people]]. During the session, Taria sat to Valorum's left in the Chancellor's podium in the center of the [[Imperial Senate Building|Galactic Senate Building]] on the Republic [[capital]] of [[Coruscant]].<ref name="TPM" />

After Naboo's [[Senator]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] began speaking before the senate and accused the Trade Federation of invading, the federation's Senator [[Lott Dod]] quickly spoke up and objected to the claim. Taria and<ref name="TPM" /> [[Vice Chair]] of the Senate,<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> [[Mas Amedda]], then stood up from their seats beside Valorum as the Supreme Chancellor cut off Dod so that Palpatine could continue. Amidala then repeated the accusation, but she too was interrupted by objections from Dod, who demanded a commission be sent to Naboo to ascertain the truth, which Senator [[Aks Moe]] of [[Malastare]] supported.<ref name="TPM" />

===Aide No Moore===
Valorum began to respond, but was interrupted by Amedda whispering in his [[ear]] as Taria looked over to watch. Valorum then looked to the [[aide]], who nodded, before the Supreme Chancellor asked Amidala if she would defer until the commission could be appointed. Amidala refused and called for a [[Vote of No Confidence]] in Valorum, leading to uproar in the Senate. Taria and a deflated Valorum then took their seats as Amedda called for order.<ref name="TPM" />

The vote removed Valorum from office, and Palpatine was soon elected as his replacement.<ref name="TPM" /> When Valorum was ousted, Taria also lost her position and was replaced by the [[Umbaran]] [[Sly Moore]] despite attempts to join Palpatine,<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> although some whispered that Moore must have threatened the committed and dedicated Taria with blackmail in order to persuade her to give up the post.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I had a walk-on role for a major film—Star Wars, Phantom Menace, as Sei Taria (Assistant to the Chancellor of the Universe—Chancellor Valurom ''[sic]''—Terence Stamp) Director: George Lucas.|Kamay Lau|<ref name="Kamay's Website">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starnow.co.uk/kamaylau|text=Kamay Lau|work=starnow—where talent gets discovered|archivedate=20161021193706}}</ref>}}
[[File:Kamaylauisseitaria.jpg|thumb|left|130px|Unreleased photos of Sei Taria can be found on Kamay Lau's website.]]
Taria was played by [[Wikipedia:British people|British]] actress [[Kamay Lau]] in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].<ref name="Kamay's Website" /> Lau's scene was filmed in front of a [[Wikipedia:Chroma key|bluescreen]] at [[Leavesden Studios]], [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Souvenir">''[[The Official Star Wars: Episode I Souvenir Magazine]]''</ref> Lau's [http://www.starnow.co.uk/kamaylau profile] on the talent directory website [http://www.starnow.com starnow] calls Taria the "Assistant to the Chancellor of the Universe", and includes two promotional photos of the character that have never been used in an official ''Star Wars'' product.<ref name="Kamay's Website" />

Though Sei Taria went unidentified in both Episode I's script<ref name="Classic Moment">{{InsiderCite|128|Classic Moment|Classic Moment: Vote of No Confidence}}</ref> and in the film's credits,<ref name="TPM" /> she was identified in [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]]' [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] 1999 reference book [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']].<ref name="EpisodeI:TVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> She was later identified in [[canon]] in [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s [[2016]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />
